schema.doc: Track C: the adult child. The volume track and the router default. 2-3 agencies received this same lead at the same moment: answering inside an hour makes us ~7x more likely to qualify than one hour later, >60x versus a day later, and roughly half of competitors do not answer a web inquiry within two hours. Speed is the entire game. Correct the archetype: 76% of family caregivers live with the parent or within 20 minutes (APFM: 83% within a 30-minute drive). Build for the LOCAL daughter who works full time: early-morning and evening windows, not business hours. Price goes in writing on day zero because she must defend the number to a sibling (money is the top sibling conflict at 36%). The day-2 two-document email is the differentiator: the buyer is not the user, 55% of families say the parent resists, and that argument must reach the mother in a form the daughter can leave on a counter. Everything past day 14 is loss recovery: two thirds of families secure care within 60 days.
schema.sla: First dial within 5 MINUTES of arrival, measured in seconds via the AI arrival timestamp. The red chip applies to Track C only.
schema.gap: Solura_For_Your_Siblings.pdf and Solura_For_Your_Mother.pdf do not exist yet; C-07 fires without them. Building them is a separate task and Meir knows.

routing.test: default - fast on the wrong track costs nothing, slow costs the lead

pricing.policy: Rate in writing on day zero (C-03). She has to defend the number to a sibling; hiding it loses the comparison by default.

steps.template: Script C.open: she filled a form minutes ago and is still at a screen. Be first and be brief: what is going on with your {ptrel}, what does help need to look like, when can we visit? Offer today or tomorrow.
Hi {dm}, Meir Schwimer at Solura Home Care. I just saw your note about care for {pt} and I tried you. If a call is bad right now, text me a good time. (216) 770-4886

steps.subject: Our rates, in writing, for {pt}
steps.template: Brief C.p1.rate: leadType shopping-around, register family-inquiry. THE RATE IN WRITING plus what it includes, three sentences of who we are, the license line. She is comparing agencies tonight and defending the number to a sibling; make both easy.
Script C.vm1: after-work window. Name, agency, saw your note about {pt}, we sent our rate so you have it in writing, number twice.

entries.subject: Two pages for the two hardest conversations
entries.template: Brief C.p2.docs: leadType decision-support, register family-inquiry. Carries Solura_For_Your_Siblings.pdf and Solura_For_Your_Mother.pdf (NOT BUILT YET, fires without them). The buyer is not the user: give her the printable argument to leave on the counter. License line.
Script C.open. Lunch window for the office worker.

entries.subject: When a parent says no to help
entries.template: Brief C.p2.mom: 55% of families hit parent resistance. What works: starting tiny, framing help as for the HOUSE, a caregiver introduced as a housekeeper first. Warm, practical, zero fear.
Script C.family: evenings are when siblings talk. Offer a three-way call or a visit when a brother or sister can join.

entries.text: Saturday morning call (weekend catch, if still unanswered)
entries.template: Script C.open. Weekend window for the lead the workweek never reaches. (Fires on the Saturday nearest day 6.)

entries.subject: Ways families cover the cost
entries.template: Brief C.p3.income: leadType decision-support. VA benefits, LTC insurance, Ohio programs, tax angles. Plain, numbered, license line.

entries.text: Day 21 re-engage: call, then VM, then text (manual, waits for Done)
entries.template: Brief C.p4.reengage: one combined touch, warm not chasing. Many families are mid-comparison right here; ask what would make the decision easier.

entries.subject: Still here when the timing is right
entries.template: Brief C.p3.d30: leadType warm-scheduled. Two thirds of families have secured care by day 60; this is recovery of the third that has not. One useful thing, soft close.
Script C.warm: no agenda, how is {pt} doing?

entries.subject: A note for the long haul
entries.template: Brief C.p3.d60: leadType long-term-nurture tone. If another agency is in place: gracious, door open, keep our number. If nothing is: smallest possible first step.

interval.template: Brief C.p5.nurture: leadType long-term-nurture, register family-inquiry. Soft italic close, no button. Quarterly: her situation changes on hospital discharges and family visits, not weeks.
